modules.module_title: Perform Service and Repair of Duct System

pcs.pc_description: Identify faults in beam clamps, conduits, dampers, pipe and duct hangers, and refrigeration lines
Inspect ducts for bends, kinks, cracks, or other physical damages.
Measure and verify return air, supply air, and duct dimensions as per system design.
Check the condition and operation of fans, blowers, and motors.
Clean ducts using appropriate robotic or manual cleaning methods
Remove scale deposits from water-cooled condensers.
Inspect and clean the drainage system of AHU (Air Handling Unit) and FCU (Fan Coil Unit).
Detect and seal air leaks in ducts effectively.
Ensure all insulation and acoustic seals are properly tightened and intact
Replace damaged or leaking dampers in the ventilation system.
Use appropriate tools and follow safety procedures while performing duct system maintenance.

modules.module_title: Perform Service and Repair of Packaged Type HVAC System

pcs.pc_description: Check, clean, and tighten electrical terminals, thermostats, and fuses
Measure and verify voltage balance across phases.
Inspect and clean the cooling tower to maintain performance
Clean evaporator and air-cooled condenser coils thoroughly.
Inspect belts, pulleys, and bearings; repair and lubricate as required.
Lubricate motor bearings following standard procedures
Clean or replace air filters to ensure proper airflow
Inspect refrigerant pressure and repair any leaks found
Check refrigerant levels and recharge gas as per manufacturer guidelines
Inspect and replace compressors and metering devices if necessary.
Adjust HVAC system controls as per operational requirements
Use correct tools and follow safe work practices during repair.
Handle refrigerants carefully, adhering to environmental and safety standards
Complete maintenance logs and service reports accurately

modules.module_title: Check Performance of Ducts and Packaged System

pcs.pc_description: Evaluate cooling and heating efficiency of the system
Measure airflow using an anemometer to ensure proper circulation
Check static pressure in the duct system for optimal performance.
Verify refrigerant charge as per system specification.
Inspect and test mechanical components, including gears, for wear or malfunction
Measure temperature drop across coils to confirm cooling efficiency.
Check system parameters and ensure they match required performance standards

modules.module_title: Maintain Safe and Efficient Work Practices

pcs.pc_description: Follow safety procedures while working on HVAC systems and always wear the required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), such as gloves, goggles, and safety shoes.
Report unsafe conditions or hazards like gas leaks, electrical faults, or damaged equipment to the supervisor or safety officer immediately.
Use tools and testing equipment properly, and check that they are in good working condition before use to avoid accidents.
Handle refrigerants, gases, and chemicals safely as per the manufacturer’s instructions and store them securely after use.
Maintain a clean and organized work area, dispose of waste properly, and use energy and materials efficiently to reduce environmental impact
